an.ui.geschichten_titel: What the dressing room is saying
an.ui.ueberspringen: Or just say nothing. That is a talk too.
an.leer.vor: There is no match coming up. The squad stays unmoved.
an.leer.halbzeit: No match, no half-time. Not even a tea-break speech.
an.leer.nach: There is no match you could talk about.
an.leer.mind: No opponent, nothing to say. The press is waiting.
an.leer.geschichten: It is quiet in the dressing room. Too quiet? The next story will come.
an.fehler.eingabe: That didn't work. Please try again.
an.fehler.kein_spiel: There is no match for that right now.
an.fehler.schon_gesagt: You have already said that. The press has noted it.
an.situation.vor.favorit: %1 are rated weaker. The trick is not to get cocky.
an.situation.vor.offen: Against %1 anything can happen. The dressing room waits for your word.
an.situation.vor.aussenseiter: %1 are rated stronger. Time for big words or clever ones.
an.situation.nach.s: Won against %1, %2. The dressing room is still humming.
an.situation.nach.u: Drew with %1, %2. Everyone is checking whether you are happy.
an.situation.nach.n: Lost to %1, %2. The dressing room is remarkably quiet.
an.situation.halbzeit.vor: Interval in your head: choose what you would say at half-time – depending on the score.
an.situation.halbzeit.nach: The match is over. Record what you said at half-time.
an.stand.frage.vor: What is the score at the break?
an.stand.frage.nach: What was the score at the break?
an.stand.rueckstand.text: Heads are down. Now it takes backbone.
an.ton.halbzeit.warm.text: A hand on the shoulder, one sentence with heart.
an.ton.halbzeit.sachlich.text: Three arrows, two crosses, a calm voice.
an.ton.halbzeit.hart.text: The door rattles, so does the tea cup.
an.mind.situation.favorit: Against %1 you are favourites: every word is weighed.
an.mind.situation.offen: The match against %1 is open. What do you say at the microphones?
an.mind.situation.aussenseiter: Against %1 you are the underdogs: a strong sentence can move a lot.
an.mind.respekt.text: You praise %1 in public: strong side, dangerous, likeable.
an.mind.respekt.echo: The press prints: "Coach with class". %1 are pleased and train twice as hard anyway.
an.mind.selbstbewusst.text: We want to win, and against %1.
an.mind.selbstbewusst.echo: Headline: "We'll take the points." The dressing room nods, the kit man pins it up.
an.mind.sticheln.text: One sentence about %1 that will be pinned up in their dressing room.
an.mind.sticheln.echo: %1 have read it. The fans laugh, the opponents less so.
an.chemie.hinweis: Estimate from the mood of the squad; morale and attitude of each player follow character and traits.
an.ui.vor_sprung: You give the talk before the match on the matchday board, with recommendation and consequences.
sp.ui.ansprache_stelle.vor: Team talk before the match: on the matchday board
sp.ui.ansprache_stelle.nach: Team talk after the match: in the match report
